# Sofie Core (`sofie-automation-sofie-core`)

Sofie Core is the central web server for the Sofie TV Automation System. Built on Meteor and Node.js, it serves Sofie’s web-based GUIs and runs the core business logic that coordinates how the system behaves.

With Sofie Core as a managed service on Eyevinn Open Source Cloud (OSC), you can start using it without standing up and maintaining your own Meteor/Node.js server. OSC handles provisioning and operations so your team can focus on integrating Sofie into your workflow instead of managing infrastructure.

Because it runs as part of OSC, Sofie Core fits into the same managed environment as your other OSC services, making it easier to adopt and operate open source components consistently across your stack.

[Source](https://github.com/Sofie-Automation/sofie-core)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "sofie-automation-sofie-core"
  name       = "mycore"

  parameters = {
    DatabaseUrl       = "..."
    # DatabaseName      = "..."
    # DbPollIntervalMs  = "..."
    # LogLevel          = "..."
    # EnableHeaderAuth  = "true"
    # PermissionsHeader = "..."
    # Timezone          = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DatabaseUrl` | string | yes |  |
| `DatabaseName` | string | no |  |
| `DbPollIntervalMs` | string | no |  |
| `LogLevel` | string | no |  |
| `EnableHeaderAuth` | boolean | no |  |
| `PermissionsHeader` | string | no |  |
| `Timezone` | string | no |  |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
